scope.input: Committed Git tree only; working copy and untracked files are not read.
scope.matching: Exact lexical identifiers, including comments/string literals; conservative review inventory.
scope.limitations: Not a compiler call graph or database access audit. Dynamic SQL, reflection, external assemblies, unlisted extensions and formal adoption evidence need independent verification.
scope.protectedCapabilities: C01/C02 identity and C03 ERP identifiers are not legacy table/entity matches merely because they start with Crm.
scope.retention: Historical migrations, tests and source-protection tools are reviewed separately; this report never authorizes deletion.
